description: The chart is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating three prompting conditions for multiple model categories, showing a numeric score for each condition within each model group. The horizontal axis contains the model categories (with visible labels including “GPT4o” and “Sonnet,” plus a leftmost group whose label is not visible in the image), arranged left to right; the vertical axis is a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 0.7 with tick marks at regular 0.1 intervals and no explicit y-axis title or units shown. Each model group contains three adjacent bars: a blue bar labeled “Basic prompt,” an orange bar labeled “Structured prompt + oracle,” and a green bar labeled “Structured prompt + predicted,” as indicated by the legend at the bottom. In the leftmost (unlabeled) group, the blue bar is approximately 0.32, the orange bar about 0.60, and the green bar about 0.35; for “GPT4o,” the blue bar is about 0.26, the orange bar about 0.58, and the green bar about 0.47; for “Sonnet,” the blue bar is about 0.34, the orange bar about 0.52, and the green bar about 0.42. The bars are not stacked and appear uniformly styled without error bars or annotations, and there is no indication that the groups are sorted by value beyond their left-to-right placement.
